title: High angular resolution evidence of dust traps from deep ALMA Band 3 observations of LkCa15
question: To test the dust trapping mechanism in the transitional disc around LkCa15, constrain its physical dust properties and azimuthal asymmetries at optically thin wavelengths, and evaluate non-dust emission in the inner disc.

recipe.goal: Calibrate, self-calibrate, and image continuum data in Bands 3, 6, and 7, and determine disc geometry and radial profiles
recipe.method: Iterative phase self-calibration of SB and SB+MB executions in CASA, flux re-scaling of MB visibilities, concatenation with LB executions, multi-scale CLEAN imaging with uv-tapering and imsmooth to a 60 mas circular beam, disc geometry estimation via visibility spread minimization and 10sigma ellipse fitting, and azimuthal averaging of brightness temperature radial profiles
key_parameters: robust = 0.0 (Band 3, Band 6), robust = 0.5 (Band 7); circular beam = 60 mas; inc = 50.1 deg, PA = 61.4 deg; DeltaRA = 0 mas, DeltaDec = 0 mas (Band 3)
assumptions: Full Planck function (no Rayleigh-Jeans approximation) for brightness temperature

recipe.goal: Perform non-parametric visibility modelling with Frankenstein, fit Gaussian rings to radial profiles, and image azimuthal residuals
recipe.method: Extract normalized visibilities, fit de-projected visibilities with Frankenstein, convolve radial profiles to a common 35 mas resolution, fit 5 symmetric Gaussian rings to both image-plane and Frankenstein radial profiles, and image visibility residuals (data minus Frankenstein model) in CASA
key_parameters: Frankenstein hyper-parameters: alpha = 1.3, w_smooth = 10^-1; common resolution = 35 mas (5.5 au)
assumptions: Axi-symmetric disc emission for Frankenstein fit; five symmetric Gaussian components (inner disc fixed at r_0 = 0, three main rings, and extended emission)

recipe.goal: Constrain radial profiles of dust temperature, dust surface density, and maximum grain size via multi-wavelength SED fitting
recipe.method: MCMC fitting of multi-wavelength continuum intensities (Bands 3, 6, 7) at each radius (> 0.1 arcsec) using the radiative transfer equation including dust scattering for DSHARP and Ricci opacities
key_parameters: Parameter space: 1 K < T_d < 300 K, 10^-6 g cm^-2 < Sigma_d < 10 g cm^-2, 10 um < a_max < 30 cm; 24 walkers, 10,000 steps; sampled every 1/3 resolution element
assumptions: Spherical grains, grain size distribution n(a) da = a^-p da with p = 3, bulk density 1.6 g cm^-3 (DSHARP) or 0.85 g cm^-3 (Ricci), absolute flux uncertainties of 10% (Band 6, 7) and 5% (Band 3)

recipe.goal: Extract integrated and inner-disc fluxes and constrain non-dust (free-free) emission
recipe.method: Compute total fluxes using curve of growth on image-plane radial profiles, measure Band 3 inner disc flux from peak value and CASA imfit, and extrapolate Band 6-7 dust spectral index to Band 3 to isolate free-free contribution and Band 3 to Band X spectral index limits
assumptions: Inner disc emission in Bands 6 and 7 originates purely from dust continuum emission, and total flux at Band X is dominated by the inner disc

recipe.goal: Simulate dust evolution and radiative transfer, and analytically evaluate dust trapping efficiency
recipe.method: Run 1D dust evolution models in Dustpy for 1 Myr with 3 Gaussian gas perturbations, generate synthetic continuum images in RADMC3D convolved to 60 mas, and apply Dullemond et al. (2018) analytical prescriptions to deconvolved Band 3 ring widths
key_parameters: Dustpy: r = 1-300 au (300 log cells), R_c = 160 au, gamma = 1, r_p = 42, 69, 101 au, A_1 = 1, A_2 = 5, A_3 = 3, alpha = 10^-4 or 10^-3, v_frag = 1 or 10 m s^-1, t = 1 Myr; RADMC3D: 64 vertical cells, T_* = 5772 K, 1e7 thermal photons, 5e6 scattering photons
assumptions: Stellar mass = 1 M_sun, static gas disc mass = 0.1 M_sun, initial gas-to-dust ratio = 100, initial grain size 0.1-1 um (MMSN), Toomre Q > 2, local gas-to-dust ratio > 1, Epstein regime, Schmidt number = 1

score_reason: The calibration, self-calibration, uv-tapering, Frankenstein hyper-parameters, MCMC priors/bounds, and Dustpy/RADMC3D setup are thoroughly documented, and the dust-property fitting code is on GitHub; minor deductions for unstated tclean cell/imsize and because self-calibrated MS files require author request or full re-reduction from raw archive data.
rediscovery_reason: Raw ALMA data are public, the self-calibration and Frankenstein/MCMC analysis steps are well specified with open-source tools (including the author's GitHub code), and key results (ring radii, FWHMs, FWHM-frequency slopes, fluxes, spectral indices, and dust masses) are quantitative.
